_base: One square card illustration for a Haredi family story game, in exactly the same look as the woman in the first reference picture. Hani (when she appears) is that woman: the same face, thin rectangular glasses, black knitted tichel covering all her hair, modest navy blouse buttoned to the collar; she is calm and modest, no raised arms. Avraham Moshe (when he appears) is the man in the second reference picture: the same face, beard and glasses, black kippah, white shirt - drawn in the same look as Hani. The children (only these three ever appear): Yanky (boy, 6, no glasses, black velvet kippah, short curly payot, white shirt with tzitzit, dark-blue trousers, a gap in his front teeth), Ruchami (girl, 5, two braids with white ribbons, small glasses, blue dress with a white collar), Malki (girl, 3, two pigtails with white clips, blue dress with a white collar, mischievous smile). Everyone is modestly dressed; women's hair covered. One clear moment, people whole, hands not cut by the edges. Nothing scary, nobody hurt. No text, no letters, no logos, no crosses.
car-1: Early morning at the apartment door: Avraham Moshe, holding his tallit bag and books, looks at his watch - he must leave early for the kollel.
car-2: Hani walks happily on a Bnei Brak sidewalk holding the hands of Ruchami and Malki, on the way to gan.
car-3: Avraham Moshe ALONE on a quiet street (NO children, NO Hani anywhere in the picture): the white family minivan has gently bumped into a pole, its front dented; he stands beside it, unhurt, hand on his forehead in surprise. The car is empty.
car-4: Avraham Moshe ALONE (NO children, NO Hani anywhere): the white minivan with a crumpled front sits on the back of a tow truck in front of a garage; he watches, safe.
car-5: At home, Hani and Avraham Moshe stand with Yanky, Ruchami and Malki, all safe and smiling, the children hugging their father, warm light, grateful.
kugel-1: In a Bnei Brak kitchen, Hani holds a tray with a kugel burnt black, a wisp of smoke, an 'oops' face.
kugel-2: Hani slides a huge golden potato kugel, twice as big, into the oven, smiling.
kugel-3: The front door opens: a Haredi family (father in a black hat, mother in a wig and modest dress, three children) arrives with a suitcase and flowers, surprise guests; Hani welcomes them.
kugel-4: On a table with a white tablecloth, the huge kugel is cut into many slices on many plates, plenty for everyone.
kugel-5: A very long Shabbat table full of guests and family, two challahs under a cover, candles lit, plenty of food, everyone happy (modest families, men in black hats, women in wigs/tichels).
rain-1: Yanky, Ruchami and Malki press their faces to a window streaming with heavy rain, a little bored.
rain-2: The whole family cosy at home on the living-room sofa while rain falls outside, a warm lamp on.
rain-3: Avraham Moshe at the dining table learning Chumash with Yanky from an open holy book, pointing at the page; Ruchami and Malki listening beside them.
rain-4: Yanky (6) stands proudly with eyes closed, reciting the weekly parsha by heart, one finger raised, a closed Chumash in his other hand, Avraham Moshe smiling beside him.
rain-5: In a cheder classroom of 6-year-old boys, a rebbe with a beard and black hat hands Yanky (6) a gold trophy and a beautiful Chumash as a prize; the other little boys clap.
dark-1: A living room suddenly dark - the power is out; the family's faces lit by one small flashlight, surprised (not scared).
dark-2: Hani lights several candles in simple candle holders on the living-room table, the room starting to glow warm.
dark-3: By candlelight Avraham Moshe and the boys sit around the table singing a niggun with their eyes closed, swaying, Hani and Malki listening with a smile.
dark-4: The front door open: neighbours from the building (a Haredi couple and an older man) come in smiling, bringing cakes and a thermos.
dark-5: A big happy melave malka gathering by candlelight in the apartment, many neighbours, cakes and drinks on the table, men singing, families together.
code-1: In a modern hi-tech office, Hani at her desk sees a big red error on her computer screen, worried.
code-2: Evening in the office, everyone has gone home, the city lights outside; Hani stays at her desk, focused on the code.
code-3: Hani ALONE at her office desk (NO children, NO Avraham Moshe, nobody else): she points at her laptop screen in a eureka moment, a magnifying glass in her hand, a bug found - a bright 'aha' face. A modern hi-tech office.
code-4: Erez, Hani's team lead (a man about 40, bald, glasses, a ginger beard, a light-blue polo shirt, smiling, no kippah) stands behind Hani's desk looking at her screen, impressed. A modern hi-tech office.
code-5: In the modern hi-tech office: Erez, Hani's team lead (a man about 40, bald, glasses, a ginger beard, a light-blue polo shirt, smiling, no kippah) hands Hani an envelope with a gold star sticker; two male colleagues in the background clapping (men only in the background, no other women); Hani smiles modestly. Avraham Moshe and children are NOT in this picture.
